intent.name: find_content
intent.description: Search the document for nodes matching type, text, or attribute criteria.

intent.name: get_node
intent.description: Retrieve a single node by target position.

intent.name: get_node_by_id
intent.description: Retrieve a single node by its unique ID.

intent.name: get_document_info
intent.description: Return document metadata including revision, node count, and capabilities.

intent.name: insert_content
intent.description: Insert text or inline content at a target position.

intent.name: replace_content
intent.description: Replace content at a target position with new text or inline content.

intent.name: delete_content
intent.description: Delete content at a target position.

intent.name: format_bold
intent.description: Toggle bold formatting on the target range.

intent.name: format_italic
intent.description: Toggle italic formatting on the target range.

intent.name: format_underline
intent.description: Toggle underline formatting on the target range.

intent.name: format_strikethrough
intent.description: Toggle strikethrough formatting on the target range.

intent.name: create_paragraph
intent.description: Create a new paragraph at the target position.

intent.name: list_lists
intent.description: List all list nodes in the document, optionally filtered by scope.

intent.name: get_list
intent.description: Retrieve a specific list node by target.

intent.name: insert_list
intent.description: Insert a new list at the target position.

intent.name: set_list_type
intent.description: Change the list type (ordered, unordered) of a target list.

intent.name: indent_list
intent.description: Increase the indentation level of a list item.

intent.name: outdent_list
intent.description: Decrease the indentation level of a list item.

intent.name: restart_list_numbering
intent.description: Restart numbering of an ordered list at the target item.

intent.name: exit_list
intent.description: Exit a list context, converting the target item to a paragraph.

intent.name: add_comment
intent.description: Add a new comment thread anchored to a target range.

intent.name: edit_comment
intent.description: Edit the content of an existing comment.

intent.name: reply_to_comment
intent.description: Add a reply to an existing comment thread.

intent.name: move_comment
intent.description: Move a comment thread to a new anchor range.

intent.name: resolve_comment
intent.description: Resolve or unresolve a comment thread.

intent.name: remove_comment
intent.description: Remove a comment or reply by ID.

intent.name: set_comment_internal
intent.description: Toggle the internal (private) flag on a comment thread.

intent.name: set_comment_active
intent.description: Set the active (focused) comment thread for UI highlighting.

intent.name: go_to_comment
intent.description: Scroll the viewport to a comment thread by ID.

intent.name: get_comment
intent.description: Retrieve a single comment thread by ID.

intent.name: list_comments
intent.description: List all comment threads in the document.

intent.name: list_tracked_changes
intent.description: List all tracked changes in the document.

intent.name: get_tracked_change
intent.description: Retrieve a single tracked change by ID.

intent.name: accept_tracked_change
intent.description: Accept a tracked change, applying it permanently.

intent.name: reject_tracked_change
intent.description: Reject a tracked change, reverting it.

intent.name: accept_all_tracked_changes
intent.description: Accept all tracked changes in the document.

intent.name: reject_all_tracked_changes
intent.description: Reject all tracked changes in the document.

intent.name: open_document
intent.description: Open a document and create a persistent editing session.

intent.name: save_document
intent.description: Save the current session to the original file or a new path.

intent.name: close_document
intent.description: Close the active editing session and clean up resources.

intent.name: get_status
intent.description: Show the current session status and document metadata.

intent.name: describe_commands
intent.description: List all available CLI operations and contract metadata.

intent.name: describe_command
intent.description: Show detailed metadata for a single CLI operation.

intent.name: list_sessions

intent.name: save_session
intent.description: Persist the current session state.

intent.name: close_session
intent.description: Close a specific editing session by ID.

intent.name: set_default_session
intent.description: Set the default session for subsequent commands.
